requirements.text: The sample(s) of the ESA shall be clearly and indelibly marked with the manufacturer's trade name or mark and the type designation.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the submitted ESA samples and confirm the manufacturer's trade name or mark and the type designation are present, clearly legible and indelible (e.g. after a rub test).

requirements.text: The electrical/electronic sub-assembly (ESA) conforming to a type approved under this Regulation shall have an approval mark described in paragraph 5.3. affixed to it, except that no marking is required for electrical/electronic systems built into vehicles which are approved as units.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the produced lamp/ESA for the presence of the R10 approval mark as described in paragraph 5.3.; pass if present.

requirements.text: The international approval mark shall comprise a circle containing the letter "E", followed by the distinguishing number of the country granting the approval.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the approval mark on the ESA; pass if it shows a circle containing "E" followed by the distinguishing number of the approving country.

requirements.text: The international approval mark shall comprise the number of this Regulation, followed by the letter "R", a dash and the approval number to the right of the circle specified in paragraph 5.3.1.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the approval mark; pass if "10R", a dash and the approval number appear to the right of the E-circle.

requirements.text: The ESA(s) shall be designed, constructed and fitted in such a way as to enable the vehicle, in normal conditions of use, to comply with the requirements of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Review design and EMC test results of the lamp ESA; pass if all R10 ESA emission and immunity requirements are met in normal operating modes.

requirements.text: The ESA(s) shall be tested for radiated and conducted emissions, for immunity to radiated and conducted disturbances.
requirements.test_case: Verify EMC test reports cover radiated and conducted emissions and radiated and conducted immunity of the lamp ESA; pass if all four test types are performed and passed.

requirements.text: The electromagnetic radiation generated by the ESA representative of its type shall be measured by the method described in Annex 7.
requirements.test_case: Review the EMC test report and confirm that broadband radiated emissions of the lamp were measured per the Annex 7 method.

requirements.text: When measurements are made using the method described in Annex 7, the limits shall be 62 to 52 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band, this limit decreasing logarithmically with frequencies above 30 MHz, and 52 to 63 dB microvolts/m in the 75 to 400 MHz band, this limit increasing logarithmically with frequencies above 75 MHz as shown in Appendix 6 to this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Measure broadband emissions per Annex 7 from 30 to 400 MHz and verify that all readings are below the logarithmic 62-52 / 52-63 dBµV/m limit line.

requirements.text: When measurements are made using the method described in Annex 7, the limit in the 400 to 1,000 MHz frequency band shall remain constant at 63 dB microvolts/m.
requirements.test_case: Measure broadband emissions per Annex 7 from 400 to 1,000 MHz and verify that all readings are below 63 dBµV/m.

requirements.text: On the ESA representative of its type, the measured values, expressed in dB microvolts/m, shall be below the type approval limits.
requirements.test_case: Compare the measured broadband emission values with the type approval limits and confirm that every value is below the limit.

requirements.text: The emission of ESA representative of its type shall be tested by the method(s) according to ISO 7637-2 as described in Annex 10 for the levels given in Table 1.
requirements.test_case: Perform the conducted transient emission test per ISO 7637-2 / Annex 10 on the lamp supply lines and compare the results with the Table 1 levels.

requirements.text: For positive polarity of pulse amplitude, the maximum allowed pulse amplitude of the transient conducted emission of the ESA shall be +75 V for vehicles with 12 V systems or +150 V for vehicles with 24 V systems as specified in Table 1.
requirements.test_case: Record the positive transient pulses on the supply line per ISO 7637-2 and verify that the peak is at most +75 V (12 V) or +150 V (24 V).

requirements.text: The immunity to electromagnetic radiation of the ESA representative of its type shall be tested by the method(s) chosen from those described in Annex 9.
requirements.test_case: Review the immunity test report and confirm that the method(s) used (Stripline, TEM cell, BCI, ALSE or reverberation chamber) are from Annex 9.

requirements.text: The ESA representative of its type shall be tested for immunity to electromagnetic radiation by the method(s) as described in Annex 9.
requirements.test_case: Confirm that the radiated immunity tests were performed per Annex 9 on the lamp.

requirements.text: The ESA representative of its type shall be tested for immunity to electromagnetic radiation such that test severity in over 90 per cent of the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency band are given in Table 2a.
requirements.test_case: Verify that the applied test levels in over 90 % of the band meet Table 2a for the chosen method (e.g. ALSE 30 V/m below 2 GHz, 10 V/m above 2 GHz) and that the lamp functions are not degraded.

requirements.text: The ESA representative of its type shall be tested for immunity to electromagnetic radiation such that test severity for the minimum test Level over the whole 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency band is as given in Table 2b.
requirements.test_case: Verify that the applied test levels over the whole band are never below the Table 2b minimum for the chosen method (e.g. ALSE 25 V/m below 2 GHz, 8 V/m above 2 GHz).

requirements.text: The ESA representative of its type shall be considered as complying with immunity requirements if, during the tests performed in accordance with Annex 9, there shall be no degradation of performance of "immunity related functions".
requirements.test_case: Run the Annex 9 radiated immunity tests on the lamp and monitor the rear position and stop lamp outputs; pass if there is no degradation of performance of immunity related functions.

requirements.text: The immunity of ESA representative of this type shall be tested by the method(s) according to ISO 16750-2 for starting profile and ISO 7637-2 for pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b, as described in Annex 10, with the test levels given in Tables 3a and 3b.
requirements.test_case: Review the test report to confirm the lamp was tested per ISO 16750-2 (starting profile) and ISO 7637-2 (pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a, 3b) as in Annex 10 at the Table 3a/3b levels.

requirements.text: For pulse 1, the ESA shall meet immunity test level -75 V (12V system) or -450 V (24V system) for 500 pulses with FPSC III for functions related to immunity and FPSC III for functions not related to immunity as specified in Table 3b.
requirements.test_case: Apply ISO 7637-2 pulse 1 at -75 V (12 V) or -450 V (24 V) for 500 pulses; pass if the lamp achieves FPSC III.

requirements.text: For pulse 3a, the ESA shall meet immunity test level -112 V (12V system) or -150 V (24V system) for 1 h with FPSC I for functions related to immunity and FPSC III for functions not related to immunity as specified in Table 3b.
requirements.test_case: Apply pulse 3a at -112 V (12 V) or -150 V (24 V) for 1 h; pass if immunity-related functions achieve FPSC I and others FPSC III.

requirements.text: The starting profile shall be tested according to the functional status classification as defined in ISO 16750-1.
requirements.test_case: Check the starting-profile test report uses the ISO 16750-1 functional status classification for pass/fail evaluation.

requirements.text: The Functional Performance Status Classification (FPSC) as in ISO 7637-1 shall be applied for pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b.
requirements.test_case: Check the pulse test report evaluates results for pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b using the ISO 7637-1 FPSC.

requirements.text: For the 12 V system starting profile (ISO 16750-2, test level II, 10 pulses), an ESA that shall be operational during engine start phases shall reach functional status class B if it performs immunity-related functions and class D if it does not, and any other ESA shall reach class C, as given in Table 3a; the starting profile applies only to ESAs that may be installed in vehicles with an internal combustion engine started by a 12 V / 24 V starter motor.
requirements.test_case: Apply the 12 V starting profile test level II for 10 pulses and verify the lamp reaches the required functional status class (B/D or C).

requirements.text: ESAs approved under this Regulation shall be so manufactured as to conform to the type approved by meeting the requirements set forth in paragraph 6. and, if applicable, in paragraph 7.
requirements.test_case: Test series-production lamps against the paragraph 6 ESA emission and immunity requirements; pass if all results match the approved type and meet the limits.

requirements.text: When the conformity of an ESA taken from the series is being verified, the levels of broadband electromagnetic disturbances and narrowband electromagnetic disturbances measured shall not exceed by more than 4 dB (60 per cent) the reference limits prescribed in paragraphs 6.5.2.1., 6.6.2.1., and, if applicable, paragraph 7.10.2.1. for ESAs (as appropriate).
requirements.test_case: Measure broadband and narrowband emissions of a series lamp per Annexes 7 and 8; pass if levels do not exceed the paragraph 6.5.2.1/6.6.2.1 limits by more than 4 dB.

requirements.text: When the conformity of an ESA taken from the series is being verified, the ESA shall not exhibit any degradation relating to the direct control of the vehicle which could be observed by the driver or other road user when subjected to a field strength, expressed in Volts/m, up to 80 per cent of the reference limits prescribed in paragraph 6.8.2.1. and, if applicable, paragraph 7.18.2.1. for ESAs.
requirements.test_case: Expose a series lamp to radiated fields up to 80 % of the Table 2a/2b levels per Annex 9; pass if no observable degradation of lamp functions occurs.

requirements.text: When the conformity of a component, or Separate Technical Unit (STU) taken from the series is being verified, the component or STU shall show no degradation of performance of "immunity related functions" up to levels given in paragraph 6.9.1. and, if applicable, paragraph 7.19.1.
requirements.test_case: Apply the ISO 7637-2 pulses at the paragraph 6.9.1 levels to a series lamp; pass if no degradation of immunity related functions occurs.

requirements.text: When the conformity of a component, or Separate Technical Unit (STU) taken from the series is being verified, the component or STU shall not exceed the conducted emission levels given in paragraph 6.7.1. and, if applicable, paragraph 7.17.1.
requirements.test_case: Measure conducted transient emissions of a series lamp on supply lines per Annex 10; pass if levels do not exceed the paragraph 6.7.1 limits.

requirements.text: The electrical/electronic sub-assembly (ESA) broadband emissions shall not exceed the reference limit E = 62 - 25.13 log (F/30) dBµV/m at frequency F (MHz) for a 120 kHz bandwidth in the 30-75 MHz frequency band (see paragraphs 6.5.2.1. and 7.10.2.1. of this Regulation).
requirements.test_case: Measure ESA broadband radiated emissions per Annex 7 with 120 kHz bandwidth in 30-75 MHz and verify all values are at or below 62 - 25.13 log (F/30) dBµV/m.

requirements.text: The electrical/electronic sub-assembly (ESA) broadband emissions shall not exceed the reference limit E = 52 + 15.13 log (F/75) dBµV/m at frequency F (MHz) for a 120 kHz bandwidth in the 75-400 MHz frequency band (see paragraphs 6.5.2.1. and 7.10.2.1. of this Regulation).
requirements.test_case: Measure ESA broadband radiated emissions with 120 kHz bandwidth in 75-400 MHz and verify all values are at or below 52 + 15.13 log (F/75) dBµV/m.

requirements.text: The electrical/electronic sub-assembly (ESA) narrowband emissions shall not exceed the reference limit E = 53 dBµV/m for a 120 kHz bandwidth in the 400-1,000 MHz frequency band (see paragraph 6.6.2.1. of this Regulation).
requirements.test_case: Measure ESA narrowband radiated emissions with 120 kHz bandwidth in 400-1,000 MHz and verify all values are at or below 53 dBµV/m.

requirements.text: If not otherwise stated in this Annex the test of broadband electromagnetic emissions from the ESA shall be performed according CISPR 25.
requirements.test_case: Review the test report and confirm the broadband radiated emission measurement of the lamp ESA was performed according to CISPR 25.

requirements.text: The ESA under test shall be in normal operation mode, preferably in maximum load.
requirements.test_case: Check the test set-up record shows the lamp operated in normal mode with its light functions energised at maximum load during the measurement.

requirements.text: For ESA other than involved in "REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid" the test shall be performed according to the ALSE method described in Clause 6.4 of CISPR 25.
requirements.test_case: Verify the test report shows the ALSE set-up of CISPR 25 Clause 6.4 was used for the lamp ESA.

requirements.text: The limits shall apply throughout the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz for measurements performed in an absorber lined shielded enclosure (ALSE) or open area test site (OATS).
requirements.test_case: Verify the lamp ESA broadband emissions were measured over the full 30 to 1,000 MHz range and remain below the applicable limits throughout.

requirements.text: When the radiated broadband emission measurements of the ESA are performed with peak detectors, a correction factor of 20 dB as defined in CISPR 12 shall be applied, the limits given in paragraphs 6.5. and 7.10. of this Regulation being for quasi-peak detectors.
requirements.test_case: Review the test report: if peak detection was used, confirm the 20 dB CISPR 12 correction was applied before comparing with the quasi-peak limits.

requirements.text: If not otherwise stated in this Annex, the test to measure the narrowband electromagnetic emissions of the ESA shall be performed according to CISPR 25.
requirements.test_case: Review the narrowband emission test report and confirm the test setup and procedure follow CISPR 25 except where Annex 8 states otherwise.

requirements.text: The narrowband emission test of the ESA shall be performed according to ALSE method described in paragraph 6.4. of CISPR 25.
requirements.test_case: Verify the test report states the ALSE method per CISPR 25 paragraph 6.4 (or a compliant OATS alternative) was used.

requirements.text: The narrowband emission measurements shall be performed with an average detector.
requirements.test_case: Check the receiver settings in the test report show an average detector was used.

requirements.text: The ESAs may comply with the requirements of the absorber chamber test according to ISO 11452-2, in any combination with the other test methods at the manufacturer's discretion, provided that these results in the full frequency range specified in paragraph 3.1. of this Annex being covered.
requirements.test_case: Review the immunity test plan/report and confirm the selected method(s) together cover the full 20 to 6,000 MHz range of paragraph 3.1.

requirements.text: The frequency range and general test conditions for the immunity testing of ESAs to electromagnetic radiation shall be based on ISO 11452-1.
requirements.test_case: Check the test report states frequency range and general test conditions per ISO 11452-1.

requirements.text: The test conditions of the ESA during tests shall be according to ISO 11452-1.
requirements.test_case: Verify the test report documents test conditions in accordance with ISO 11452-1.

requirements.text: The ESA under test shall be switched on.
requirements.test_case: Confirm in the test setup record that the lamp ESA was powered on throughout the immunity exposure.

requirements.text: The ESA under test shall be stimulated to be in normal operation condition.
requirements.test_case: Confirm the lamp functions (rear position, stop, reversing) were operated in normal operating mode during exposure and monitored.

requirements.text: The ESA under test shall be arranged as defined in this Annex unless individual test methods dictate otherwise.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the test setup photos/description against the arrangement defined in Annex 9 and the applicable ISO 11452 part.

requirements.text: The measurements shall be made in the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency range with frequency steps according to ISO 11452-1.
requirements.test_case: Verify the test report covers 20 to 6,000 MHz with frequency steps per ISO 11452-1 and the ESA meets the immunity criteria over that range.

requirements.text: The test signal modulation shall be AM (amplitude modulation), with 1 kHz modulation and 80 per cent modulation depth in the 20 to 400 MHz frequency range, if not otherwise agreed between Technical Service and ESA manufacturer.
requirements.test_case: Check the test report shows AM 1 kHz, 80 per cent depth applied from 20 to 400 MHz with the ESA meeting its immunity criteria.

requirements.text: The test signal modulation shall be PM2 (pulse modulation type 2), Ton 3 µs, period 3,333 µs in the 2,700 to 3,100 MHz frequency range, if not otherwise agreed between Technical Service and ESA manufacturer.
requirements.test_case: Check the test report shows PM2 (Ton 3 µs, period 3,333 µs) applied from 2,700 to 3,100 MHz with the ESA meeting its immunity criteria.

requirements.text: The test signal modulation shall be PM3 (pulse modulation type 3), Ton 500 µs, period 1,000 µs in the 380 to 2,700 MHz and the 3,100 to 6,000 MHz frequency ranges, if not otherwise agreed between Technical Service and ESA manufacturer.
requirements.test_case: Check the test report shows PM3 (Ton 500 µs, period 1,000 µs) applied from 380 to 2,700 MHz and 3,100 to 6,000 MHz with the ESA meeting its immunity criteria.

requirements.text: The frequency step size and dwell time shall be chosen according to ISO 11452-1.
requirements.test_case: Verify the documented step size and dwell time comply with ISO 11452-1.

requirements.text: For the absorber chamber test, the "substitution method" shall be used to establish the test field conditions according to ISO 11452-2.
requirements.test_case: Check the absorber chamber test report states field calibration by the substitution method per ISO 11452-2.

requirements.text: The absorber chamber test shall be performed with vertical polarization.
requirements.test_case: Verify the absorber chamber test report shows antenna in vertical polarization and the ESA meeting its immunity criteria.

requirements.text: The bulk current injection test of the ESA shall be performed according to ISO 11452-4 on a test bench with the BCI test method with substitution method and injection probe positioned at 150 mm distance to the ESA, or the BCI test method with closed loop method and injection probe positioned at 900 mm distance to the ESA, except that as an alternative the ESA may be tested while installed in the vehicle according to ISO 11451-4 with the BCI test method with substitution method and injection probe positioned at 150 mm distance to the ESA.
requirements.test_case: Review the EMC test report and confirm BCI testing per ISO 11452-4 with probe at 150 mm (substitution) or 900 mm (closed loop), or in-vehicle per ISO 11451-4 at 150 mm.

requirements.text: For immunity against transient disturbances conducted along 12/24 V supply lines, the test pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b according to the International Standard ISO 7637-2 shall be applied to the supply lines as well as to other connections of ESAs which may be operationally connected to supply lines.
requirements.test_case: Apply ISO 7637-2 pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b to the lamp's supply lines and operationally connected inputs and verify the required FPSC is reached.

requirements.text: For immunity against transient disturbances conducted along 12/24 V supply lines, the starting profile according to the International Standard ISO 16750-2 shall be applied to the supply lines as well as to other connections of ESAs which may be operationally connected to supply lines, except that ESAs that are exclusively reserved for mounting on electric vehicles (vehicles without 12V/24V starter motor) are not subject to starting profile.
requirements.test_case: Apply the ISO 16750-2 starting profile to the lamp's supply lines (unless exclusively for electric vehicles) and verify the required functional status class.

requirements.text: The emission of transient conducted disturbances generated by ESAs on 12/24 V supply lines shall be measured according to the International Standard ISO 7637-2 on supply lines as well as to other connections of ESAs which may be operationally connected to supply lines.
requirements.test_case: Measure transient emissions from the lamp on its supply lines and operationally connected lines per ISO 7637-2 and confirm compliance with the regulation limits.

requirements.text: The lighting and light-signalling devices shall be so fitted that under normal conditions of use as defined in paragraphs 2.3.10., 2.3.10.1. and 2.3.10.2. and notwithstanding any vibrations to which they may be subjected, the lighting and light-signalling devices retain the characteristics prescribed by this Regulation and enable the vehicle to comply with the requirements of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the installed lamp after vibration exposure under normal conditions of use and verify that its photometric and geometric characteristics remain within the Regulation's limits.

requirements.text: It shall not be possible for the lamps to be inadvertently maladjusted.
requirements.test_case: Check the mounting (fasteners, mounting holes) on the vehicle and verify that the lamp cannot be shifted out of aim without deliberate tool action.

requirements.text: For all light-signalling devices, including those mounted on the side panels, the reference axis of the lamp when fitted to the vehicle shall be parallel to the bearing plane of the vehicle on the road.
requirements.test_case: Measure the installed lamp's reference axis relative to the road bearing plane; it must be parallel within ±3°.

requirements.text: The reference axis of the lamp when fitted to the vehicle shall be parallel to the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle in the case of all other signalling devices than side retro-reflectors and side-marker lamps.
requirements.test_case: Measure the installed lamp's reference axis relative to the median longitudinal plane; it must be parallel within ±3°.

requirements.text: In each direction a tolerance of ±3° shall be allowed for the reference axis of the light-signalling device when fitted to the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Verify the measured deviation of the reference axis in each direction does not exceed ±3°.

requirements.text: Any specific instructions as regards fitting laid down by the manufacturer shall be complied with for the light-signalling devices.
requirements.test_case: Compare the installation with the manufacturer's fitting instructions; all instructions must be followed.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, the height and orientation of the lamps shall be verified with the vehicle unladen and placed on a flat, horizontal surface, in the condition defined in paragraphs 2.3.10., 2.3.10.1. and 2.3.10.2. and, in the case where an AFS is installed, with the system in its neutral state.
requirements.test_case: Measure lamp height and orientation with the vehicle unladen on a flat horizontal surface in the defined condition.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions lamps constituting a pair shall be fitted to the vehicle symmetrically in relation to the median longitudinal plane (this estimate to be based on the exterior geometrical form of the lamp and not on the edge of its illuminating surface referred to in paragraph 2.10.3.).
requirements.test_case: Measure left and right lamp positions on the vehicle; exterior forms must be symmetrical about the median longitudinal plane.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions lamps constituting a pair shall be symmetrical to one another in relation to the median longitudinal plane, except that this requirement is not valid with regard to the interior structure of the lamp.
requirements.test_case: Compare left and right lamp exterior geometry; they must be mirror-symmetrical about the median longitudinal plane.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions lamps constituting a pair shall satisfy the same colorimetric requirements.
requirements.test_case: Measure chromaticity of each lamp of the pair; both must meet the same colour requirements.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions lamps constituting a pair shall have substantially identical photometric characteristics, except that this shall not apply to a matched pair of a function and/or an AFS.
requirements.test_case: Compare photometric measurements of left and right lamps; they must be substantially identical.

requirements.text: In case of lamps incorporating a manufacturer logo, only two lateral logos (one on each side) or one central logo shall be fitted on the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the vehicle rear; no more than two lateral logos (one per side) or one central logo in lamps.

requirements.text: In case of lamps incorporating a logo, all logos that are not vehicle manufacturer or body manufacturer logos shall be prohibited.
requirements.test_case: Inspect any logo in the lamp; it must be a vehicle or body manufacturer logo.

requirements.text: Lamps may be grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated with one another only provided that all requirements regarding colour, position, orientation, geometric visibility, electrical connections and other requirements, if any, are fulfilled.
requirements.test_case: Verify each grouped/combined function of the rear lamp individually meets its colour, position, orientation, visibility and connection requirements.

requirements.text: The photometric and colorimetric requirements of a lamp shall be fulfilled when all other functions with which this lamp is grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated are switched OFF.
requirements.test_case: Measure photometry and colour of each function with all other functions of the lamp switched off; limits must be met.

requirements.text: When a front or rear position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with one or more other function(s) which can be switched ON together with them, the requirements regarding colour of each of these other functions shall be fulfilled when the reciprocally incorporated function(s) and the front or rear position lamps are switched ON.
requirements.test_case: Switch on the rear position lamp together with the reciprocally incorporated function and measure the colour; it must be within limits.

requirements.text: Single lamps as defined in paragraph 2.14.11.1., subparagraph (a), the apparent surface of which is composed of two or more distinct parts, shall be installed in such a way that either the total area of the projection of the distinct parts of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis on a plane tangent to the exterior surface of the outer lens and perpendicular to the reference axis shall occupy not less than 60 per cent of the smallest quadrilateral circumscribing the projection of the said apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis, or the minimum distance between the facing edges of two adjacent/tangential distinct parts of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis shall not exceed 75 mm when measured perpendicularly to the reference axis, except that these requirements shall not apply to a single retro-reflector.
requirements.test_case: Project the distinct apparent surface parts along the reference axis; check area ratio ≥60 % of circumscribing quadrilateral or gap ≤75 mm.

requirements.text: Red light emitted by a lamp fitted on the rear of the vehicle (as defined in paragraph 2.1.5.) shall not be visible from the front of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: With the lamp installed on the vehicle, observe from the front of the vehicle and confirm no red light from the rear lamp is visible.

requirements.text: The maximum height above the ground shall be measured from the highest point and the minimum height from the lowest point of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis, except that where the (maximum and minimum) height above the ground clearly meets the requirements of the Regulation, the exact edges of any surface need not be determined.
requirements.test_case: Measure mounting height from the highest and lowest points of each function's apparent surface along the reference axis.

requirements.text: For the purposes of reducing the geometric visibility angles, the position of a lamp with regard to height above the ground shall be measured from the H plane.
requirements.test_case: Where reduced visibility angles are claimed, measure lamp height from the H plane and confirm the reduction criterion.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, the photometric characteristics (e.g. intensity, colour, apparent surface, etc.) of a lamp shall not be intentionally varied during the period when the lamp is switched ON.
requirements.test_case: Operate each function (rear position, stop, reversing) continuously and verify by photometer/observation that intensity, colour and apparent surface remain constant while switched ON.

requirements.text: The photometric characteristics of any lamp may vary in relation to the ambient light, provided that any variation in the photometric characteristics is in compliance with the technical provisions for the lamp concerned.
requirements.test_case: Vary ambient light conditions and verify each resulting photometric state meets the device regulation limits for the lamp.

requirements.text: The photometric characteristics of any lamp may vary as a consequence of other lamps being switched ON or OFF, provided that any variation in the photometric characteristics is in compliance with the technical provisions for the lamp concerned.
requirements.test_case: Switch other lamps ON/OFF and measure the rear position lamp photometry, confirming each state complies with its device regulation.

requirements.text: The photometric characteristics of any lamp may vary when the lamp is being used to provide another lighting function, provided that any variation in the photometric characteristics is in compliance with the technical provisions for the lamp concerned.
requirements.test_case: Operate the shared lamp in each function and verify photometry for each function meets its device regulation limits.

requirements.text: To verify paragraph 5.10.1., for the visibility of red light towards the front of a vehicle, with the exception of a red rearmost side-marker lamp, there shall be no direct visibility of the apparent surface of a red lamp if viewed by an observer moving within Zone 1 in a transverse plane situated 25 m in front of the vehicle (see Annex 4).
requirements.test_case: Perform the Annex 4 Zone 1 sight-line check at 25 m in front of the vehicle and confirm no direct view of the red lamp's apparent surface.

requirements.text: In case of doubt, the requirement of paragraph 5.10.4.1. shall be deemed fulfilled if the luminous intensity of the red light emitted to the front, as verified during type approval of the lamps, is not more than 0.25 cd per lamp taking into account the influence of the vehicle body if applicable.
requirements.test_case: Measure luminous intensity of red light emitted towards the front of the lamp (with vehicle body influence if applicable) and confirm it is not more than 0.25 cd per lamp.

requirements.text: The electrical connections shall be such that the front and rear position lamps, the end-outline marker lamps, if they exist, the side-marker lamps, if they exist, and the rear registration plate lamp can only be switched ON and OFF simultaneously, except that this requirement does not apply while front and rear position lamps, as well as side-marker lamps when combined or reciprocally incorporated with said lamps, are switched ON as parking lamps, side-marker lamps flash in conjunction with direction indicators, daytime running lamps are switched ON, or front position lamps function is substituted under the provisions of paragraph 5.12.1.
requirements.test_case: Operate the vehicle lighting switch and verify the rear position lamps switch ON and OFF simultaneously with the front position lamps and rear registration plate lamp, outside the listed exceptions.

requirements.text: The concealment of lamps shall be prohibited, with the exception of the main-beam headlamps, the dipped-beam headlamps and the front fog lamps, which may be concealed when they are not in use.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the installed rear lamp and confirm no concealment device covers the rear position, stop or reversing lamps or retro-reflector.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall emit white light.
requirements.test_case: Measure the chromaticity of the reversing lamp light and confirm it lies within the white colour boundaries.

requirements.text: The stop lamp shall emit red light.
requirements.test_case: Measure the chromaticity of the stop lamp light and confirm it lies within the red colour boundaries.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp shall emit red light.
requirements.test_case: Measure the chromaticity of the rear position lamp light and confirm it lies within the red colour boundaries.

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector, non-triangular, shall be red.
requirements.test_case: Measure the colour of the light reflected by the retro-reflector and confirm it lies within the red colour boundaries.

requirements.text: The number of lamps mounted on the vehicle shall be equal to the number indicated in the individual specifications of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Count the rear position, stop and reversing lamps and retro-reflectors fitted on the vehicle and compare with the numbers in the individual specifications.

requirements.text: Any lamp may be installed on movable components provided that the conditions specified in paragraphs 5.18., 5.19. and 5.20. are fulfilled.
requirements.test_case: If the lamp is on a movable component, verify compliance with paragraphs 5.18., 5.19. and 5.20.

requirements.text: Rear position lamps and rear retro-reflectors, triangular as well as non-triangular, may be installed on movable components only if at all fixed positions of the movable components the lamps on the movable components meet all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for those lamps.
requirements.test_case: With the movable component at each fixed position, check position, geometric visibility, colour and photometry of the rear position lamp and retro-reflector.

requirements.text: When the movable components are in a position other than a "normal position of use", the devices installed on them shall not cause undue discomfort to road users.
requirements.test_case: With the movable component open, assess that the lamps do not cause undue discomfort (glare) to road users.

requirements.text: When a lamp is installed on a movable component and the movable component is in the "normal position(s) of use", the lamp shall always return to the position(s) specified by the manufacturer in accordance with this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Operate the movable component repeatedly and verify the lamp returns to the manufacturer-specified position in the normal position of use.

requirements.text: The apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of front and rear position lamps, front and rear direction-indicator lamps and retro-reflectors shall not be hidden more than 50 per cent by any movable component, with or without a light-signalling device installed on it, in any fixed position different from the "normal position of use".
requirements.test_case: Place each movable component in each fixed position and measure the hidden share of the apparent surface along the reference axis; pass if not more than 50 per cent.

requirements.text: Rear position lamps of category R2 and stop lamps of category S2 with variable luminous intensity control, which respond simultaneously to one or more of the conditions listed in paragraphs 5.26.1. and 5.26.2., shall be allowed, provided that the intensity of the all lamps mentioned above, when combined, grouped or reciprocally incorporated, vary all together in the same manner and in a similar proportion.
requirements.test_case: Vary the triggering conditions and measure intensities; pass if all combined/grouped/reciprocally incorporated lamps vary together in similar proportion.

requirements.text: For rear position lamps of category R2 and stop lamps of category S2 with variable luminous intensity control, in the entire intensity range, the specific prescribed ratio between the luminous intensities of two lamps, if applicable, shall be maintained throughout variation transitions.
requirements.test_case: Measure stop/rear position lamp intensities across the variation range; pass if the prescribed ratio is maintained throughout transitions.

requirements.text: For vehicles of M and N categories, when the electrical system of the vehicle is in a constant voltage operating condition, representative for the relevant category of powered vehicle as specified by the applicant, in all cases of electric power supply conditions not covered by paragraph 5.27.1., the voltage at the terminals of the device(s) or function(s) shall not exceed 6.75 V (6 Volt-Systems), 13.5 V (12 Volt-Systems) or 28 V (24 Volt-Systems) by more than 3 per cent, except that this shall not apply to devices which include an electronic light source control gear, or a variable intensity control being part of the device, or only light source(s) approved according to UN Regulation No. 128.
requirements.test_case: Measure terminal voltage of each lamp function at constant voltage operation; pass if not exceeding 13.5 V (12 V) or 28 V (24 V) by more than 3 per cent.

requirements.text: There shall be no obstacle on the inside of the angles of geometric visibility to the propagation of light from any part of the apparent surface of the lamp observed from infinity, except that no account is taken of obstacles, if they were already presented when the lamp was type-approved.
requirements.test_case: On the vehicle, check from infinity (parallel observation) across the prescribed geometric visibility angles of each function that no vehicle part obstructs light from any part of the apparent surface, other than obstacles present at lamp type approval.

requirements.text: If, when the lamp is installed, any part of the apparent surface of the lamp is hidden by any further parts of the vehicle, proof shall be furnished that the part of the lamp not hidden by obstacles still conforms to the photometric values prescribed for the approval of the device.
requirements.test_case: Where masking exists, measure photometry of the lamp with the hidden portion masked and confirm the values still meet the device approval photometric requirements.

requirements.text: All lamps (devices) shall, where applicable, be type approved according to the corresponding device Regulations as specified in the relevant subparagraphs of paragraph 6 of this Regulation when installed on a vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Verify the rear position, stop, reversing lamp and retro-reflector functions carry valid type approvals and approval marks under the device Regulations referenced in paragraph 6.

requirements.text: Lamps installed on a vehicle which is approved according to this Regulation and approved for one or more replaceable light source categories according to Regulations Nos. 37, 99 or 128, shall be fitted with light sources approved according to these light source categories only, except that this requirement does not concern light source modules, LED modules and non-replaceable light sources, except for when they are required to be approved by the applicable Regulation.
requirements.test_case: If the lamp uses replaceable light sources, inspect fitted light sources and confirm they carry R37/R99/R128 approvals of the categories stated in the lamp approval.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall be mandatory on motor vehicles and on trailers of categories O2, O3 and O4.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the M1 vehicle and confirm at least one reversing lamp is fitted.

requirements.text: One reversing lamp device shall be mandatory and a second device optional on motor vehicles of category M1 and on all other vehicles with a length not exceeding 6,000 mm.
requirements.test_case: Count the reversing lamps on the M1 vehicle; pass if one or two are fitted.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp devices shall be type-approved according to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 23, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.test_case: Check the lamp carries a valid UN R23 or UN R148 approval mark and certificate for the reversing lamp function.

requirements.text: The reversing lamps shall be at a height of not less than 250 mm and not more than 1,200 mm above the ground, except that for category N2G, N3G, M2G, M3G (off-road) vehicles the maximum height may be increased to 1,400 mm.
requirements.test_case: Measure the height of the reversing lamp above ground on the vehicle; pass if between 250 mm and 1,200 mm.

requirements.text: The reversing lamps shall be positioned in length at the rear of the vehicle, except that, if installed, the two optional devices mentioned in paragraph 6.4.2.2. may be fitted on the side of the vehicle, provided that the requirements of paragraphs 6.4.5.2. and 6.4.6.2. are fulfilled.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the vehicle installation and confirm the reversing lamp is mounted at the rear of the vehicle.

requirements.text: The geometric visibility of reversing lamp devices installed at the rear of the vehicle shall be defined by angles α and β, as specified in paragraph 2.10.7.: α = 15° upwards and 5° downwards, β = 45° to right and to left if there is only one device, 45° outwards and 30° inwards if there are two.
requirements.test_case: Verify on the installed lamp that the apparent surface is visible over α = +15°/-5° and β = 45° left/right (one device) or 45° outwards/30° inwards (two devices).

requirements.text: The reversing lamps shall be oriented rearwards.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the installation and confirm the reversing lamp reference axis points rearwards.

requirements.text: The electrical connections of the reversing lamp shall be such that the lamp can be switched ON only if the reverse gear is engaged and if the device which controls the starting and stopping of the propulsion system is in such a position that operation of the propulsion system is possible.
requirements.test_case: Functionally test on the vehicle: the lamp lights only with reverse gear engaged and the propulsion system in an operable state.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall not switch ON or remain ON if either the reverse gear is not engaged or the device which controls the starting and stopping of the propulsion system is not in such a position that operation of the propulsion system is possible.
requirements.test_case: Disengage reverse gear and separately switch off the propulsion system; pass if the lamp does not switch on or turns off in each case.

requirements.text: The tell-tale for the reversing lamp shall be optional, except that a tell-tale indicating failure is mandatory if required by the component regulation.
requirements.test_case: Review component regulation (R23/R148) for failure tell-tale requirement; if required, verify on vehicle that a failure tell-tale is provided and operates on simulated reversing lamp failure.

requirements.text: Devices of S1 or S2 categories shall be mandatory on all categories of vehicles.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the vehicle installation and confirm that S1 or S2 category stop lamp devices are fitted.

requirements.text: The S1 or S2 category devices shall be type-approved according to the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 7, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.test_case: Check the approval mark and certificate of the stop lamp for R7 02-series or later, or R148 00-series or later.

requirements.text: All categories of vehicles shall be equipped with two S1 or S2 category devices and one S3 or S4 category device.
requirements.test_case: Count the stop lamps on the vehicle and confirm two S1/S2 devices and one S3/S4 device are present.

requirements.text: For M1 and N1 category vehicles, for S1 or S2 categories devices the point on the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Measure on the vehicle the distance from the outermost point of the stop lamp apparent surface to the vehicle's extreme outer edge; pass if ≤ 400 mm.

requirements.text: The S1 or S2 categories devices shall be at a height above the ground of not less than 350 mm nor more than 1,500 mm (2,100 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 1,500 mm and if the optional lamps are not installed).
requirements.test_case: Measure the stop lamp apparent surface height above ground per paragraph 5.8.1; pass if between 350 mm and 1,500 mm (or 2,100 mm where justified).

requirements.text: The S1 or S2 categories devices shall be positioned in length at the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the vehicle installation and confirm the stop lamp is located at the rear of the vehicle.

requirements.text: The geometric visibility horizontal angle for S1 or S2 categories devices shall be 45° to the left and to the right of the longitudinal axis of the vehicle, except that for the stop lamps of categories S1 and S2 mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.
requirements.test_case: Verify on the vehicle that the stop lamp apparent surface is visible over 45° inward and outward (20° inward below H if mounted below 750 mm).

requirements.text: The geometric visibility vertical angle for S1 or S2 categories devices shall be 15° above and below the horizontal, except that (a) where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°; (b) where an optional lamp is mounted above 2,100 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above) the upward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.test_case: Verify on the vehicle that the stop lamp apparent surface is visible 15° above and below horizontal (5° downward if mounted below 750 mm).

requirements.text: The stop lamps shall be oriented towards the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the installed lamp and confirm the stop lamp reference axis points towards the rear of the vehicle.

requirements.text: All stop lamps shall be switched ON simultaneously when the braking system provides the relevant signal defined in UN Regulations Nos. 13 and 13-H.
requirements.test_case: Apply the brake signal on the vehicle and confirm all stop lamps illuminate simultaneously.

requirements.text: The rear position lamps (devices of R or R1 or R2 categories) shall be mandatory.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the vehicle installation and approval documents to confirm that rear position lamps of category R, R1 or R2 are fitted.

requirements.text: The vehicle shall be equipped with two rear position lamps, type-approved according to the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 7, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.test_case: Count the rear position lamps on the vehicle and check that each carries an approval mark to UN R7 02+ series or UN R148 00+ series.

requirements.text: In width, that point on the apparent surface of the rear position lamp in the direction of the reference axis which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle, except that this condition shall not apply to the optional rear lamps.
requirements.test_case: Measure the lateral distance from the outermost point of the apparent surface along the reference axis to the vehicle's extreme outer edge; pass if it is at most 400 mm.

requirements.text: In length, the rear position lamps shall be placed at the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the installation to confirm the rear position lamps are located at the rear of the vehicle.

requirements.text: The rear position lamps shall have a horizontal angle of geometric visibility of 45° inwards and 80° outwards, except that where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1.), the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.
requirements.test_case: Verify on the installed lamp that the apparent surface is visible over 45° inwards (or 20° below H plane if mounted below 750 mm) and 80° outwards.

requirements.text: The rear position lamps shall have a vertical angle of geometric visibility of 15° above and below the horizontal, except that (a) where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1.), the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°; (b) where an optional lamp is mounted above 2,100 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1.) the upward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.test_case: Verify on the installed lamp that the apparent surface is visible 15° above and 15° below the horizontal (5° downward if mounted below 750 mm).

requirements.text: For M1 and N1 category vehicles, as an alternative to paragraph 6.10.5.1., at the discretion of the manufacturer or his duly accredited representative, and only if a rear side-marker lamp is installed on the vehicle, the horizontal angle of geometric visibility of the rear position lamps shall be 45° outwards to 45° inwards, except that where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1.), the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.
requirements.test_case: Measure the visibility of the rear position lamp's apparent surface on the vehicle from 45° outwards to 45° inwards (20° inwards under the H plane if mounted below 750 mm); pass if visible over the whole range.

requirements.text: For M1 and N1 category vehicles, as an alternative to paragraph 6.10.5.1., at the discretion of the manufacturer or his duly accredited representative, and only if a rear side-marker lamp is installed on the vehicle, the vertical angle of geometric visibility of the rear position lamps shall be 15° above and below the horizontal, except that where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1.), the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.test_case: Check visibility of the rear position lamp from 15° above to 15° below the horizontal (5° below if mounted below 750 mm); pass if visible over the whole range.

requirements.text: For M1 and N1 category vehicles, where the alternative of paragraph 6.10.5.2 is applied, to be considered visible, the rear position lamp shall provide an unobstructed view of the apparent surface of at least 12.5 square centimetres, the illuminating surface area of any retro-reflector that does not transmit light being excluded.
requirements.test_case: Determine the unobstructed projected apparent surface at each limit angle, excluding the non-light-transmitting retro-reflector area; pass if at least 12.5 cm².

requirements.text: The rear position lamps shall be oriented rearwards.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the installed lamp; pass if the reference axis of the rear position lamp points rearwards.

requirements.text: The electrical connections of the rear position lamps shall be in accordance with paragraph 5.11., except that if a rear position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with a direction-indicator, the electrical connection of the rear position lamp on the relevant side of the vehicle or the reciprocally incorporated part of it may be such that it is switched OFF during the entire time (both ON and OFF cycle) of operation of the direction-indicator lamp.
requirements.test_case: Review the wiring diagram and operate the lighting switch on the vehicle; pass if the rear position lamps switch per paragraph 5.11.

requirements.text: A closed-circuit tell-tale shall be mandatory for the rear position lamps.
requirements.test_case: Switch ON the rear position lamps and verify a closed-circuit tell-tale is lit in the driver's view; pass if present.

requirements.text: The closed-circuit tell-tale of the rear position lamps shall be combined with that of the front position lamps, except that this requirement does not apply when daytime running lamps are switched ON.
requirements.test_case: Verify with the position lamps switched ON that a single common tell-tale indicates front and rear position lamps; pass if combined.

requirements.text: A tell-tale indicating failure of the rear position lamps shall be mandatory if required by the component Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Check the component Regulation; if required, simulate lamp failure and verify a failure tell-tale is activated.

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector, non-triangular, shall be mandatory on motor vehicles.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the M1 vehicle rear and confirm that non-triangular rear retro-reflectors are fitted.

requirements.text: The number of rear retro-reflectors, non-triangular, shall be two, type-approved according to the requirements concerning Class IA or IB retro-reflectors in the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 3, or in the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 150.
requirements.test_case: Count the rear retro-reflectors on the vehicle (two required) and verify each carries a Class IA or IB approval mark under UN R3 02+ series or UN R150 00+ series.

requirements.text: In width, that point on the illuminating surface of the rear retro-reflector, non-triangular, which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Measure on the vehicle the lateral distance from the outermost point of the retro-reflector illuminating surface to the extreme outer edge of the vehicle; pass if ≤ 400 mm.

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector, non-triangular, shall be at a height above the ground of not less than 250 mm nor more than 900 mm (not more than 1,200 mm if grouped with any rear lamp(s), 1,500 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 900 mm or 1200 mm respectively).
requirements.test_case: Measure the height of the retro-reflector illuminating surface above ground on the unladen vehicle; pass if between 250 mm and 900 mm (1,200 mm if grouped with rear lamps, 1,500 mm if bodywork shape requires).

requirements.text: In length, the rear retro-reflector, non-triangular, shall be at the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the vehicle and confirm the retro-reflector is located at the rear of the vehicle.

requirements.text: The geometric visibility of the rear retro-reflector, non-triangular, shall be a horizontal angle of 30° inwards and outwards.
requirements.test_case: Check on the vehicle that the retro-reflector illuminating surface is unobstructed within 30° inwards and outwards horizontally.

requirements.text: The geometric visibility of the rear retro-reflector, non-triangular, shall be a vertical angle of 10° above and below horizontal, except that where a retro-reflector is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1.), the downward angle of 10° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.test_case: Check on the vehicle that the retro-reflector is unobstructed 10° above and 10° below horizontal (5° below if mounted below 750 mm per paragraph 5.8.1.).

requirements.text: The illuminating surface of the rear retro-reflector, non-triangular, shall be permitted to have parts in common with the apparent surface of any other lamp situated at the rear.
requirements.test_case: Review the lamp drawing to identify any overlap of the retro-reflector illuminating surface with other rear lamp apparent surfaces and confirm it is acceptable under this permission.

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflectors, non-triangular, shall have a horizontal angle of geometric visibility of 30° inwards and outwards.
requirements.test_case: On the vehicle (or a CAD visibility study), check that the illuminating surface of the retro-reflector is unobstructed at 30° inwards and 30° outwards.

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflectors, non-triangular, shall have a vertical angle of geometric visibility of 15° above and below the horizontal, except that where a retro-reflector is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.test_case: Measure the mounting height per paragraph 5.8.1 and verify an unobstructed view of the illuminating surface at 15° up and 15° down (or 5° down if mounted below 750 mm).

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflectors, non-triangular, shall be oriented rearwards.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the installed lamp and check that the retro-reflector reference axis points rearwards, parallel to the vehicle longitudinal axis.

requirements.text: When daytime running lamps are switched ON, the rear position lamps shall be switched ON, except that the rear position lamps and the other lamp(s) mentioned in paragraph 5.11. may be switched OFF when the daytime running lamps are switched ON, and may remain switched OFF as long as the ambient light conditions outside vehicle are above 7,000 lux (measured according to the requirements of Annex 13).
requirements.test_case: On the vehicle, switch the daytime running lamps ON (ambient light at or below 7,000 lux per Annex 13) and verify that the rear position lamps are switched ON.

requirements.text: The emergency stop signal shall be given by the simultaneous operation of all the stop or direction-indicator lamps fitted as described in paragraph 6.23.7.
requirements.test_case: Trigger the emergency braking logic signal above 50 km/h and verify that all stop lamps operate simultaneously.

requirements.text: All the lamps of the emergency stop signal shall flash in phase at a frequency of 4.0 ± 1.0 Hz.
requirements.test_case: Activate the emergency stop signal, record the stop lamp outputs and verify in-phase flashing at 3.0 to 5.0 Hz.

requirements.text: For control of conformity of production, the values measured for the distances of the position of lamps shall be such that the individual specifications applicable to each lamp are fulfilled.
requirements.test_case: Compare measured mounting distances of the rear position, stop and reversing lamps and retro-reflector with their individual specifications; all values within limits.

requirements.text: For control of conformity of production, the position of lamps, as defined in paragraph 2.1.6. of this Regulation, in width, in height and in length shall be checked in accordance with the general requirements set out in paragraphs 2.10.2., 2.10.3., 2.10.4., 2.3.3. and 5.4. of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: On a production vehicle, measure the width, height and length position of the rear lamp per paragraphs 2.10.2.-2.10.4., 2.3.3. and 5.4.; the check is documented.

requirements.text: For control of conformity of production, the values measured for the angles of geometric visibility shall be such that the individual specifications applicable to each lamp are fulfilled, except that the limits of the angles may have an allowance corresponding to the ±3º variation permitted in paragraph 5.3. for the mounting of the light-signalling devices.
requirements.test_case: Measure visibility angles (e.g. reversing lamp 45° outboard) on a production vehicle; values meet the lamp specifications within the ±3° allowance.

requirements.text: For control of conformity of production, the angles of geometric visibility of lamps shall be checked in accordance with paragraph 2.10.7. of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: On a production vehicle, check the geometric visibility angles of each rear lamp function per paragraph 2.10.7.; the check is documented.

requirements.text: For control of conformity of production, the visibility of red light towards the front and of white light towards the rear shall be checked in accordance with paragraph 5.10. of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: On a production vehicle, check per paragraph 5.10. that no red light from the rear lamp is visible from the front and no white light (other than permitted reversing lamp) is visible from the rear.

requirements.text: For control of conformity of production, the lamps and tell-tales shall function in accordance with the provisions set out in paragraphs 5.11. to 5.14. of this Regulation and with the individual specifications applicable to each lamp.
requirements.test_case: Verify on a production vehicle that switching logic and tell-tales of the rear lamp functions comply with paragraphs 5.11.-5.14. and the individual lamp specifications.

requirements.text: For control of conformity of production, the electrical connections shall be checked by switching on every lamp supplied by the electrical system of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Switch on the rear position, stop and reversing lamp functions via the vehicle electrical system on a production vehicle; each lamp operates.

requirements.text: For control of conformity of production, the presence, number, colour, arrangement and, where applicable, the category of lamps shall be such that the requirements set out in paragraphs 5.15. and 5.16. as well as in the individual specifications applicable to each lamp are fulfilled.
requirements.test_case: Confirm by visual inspection that the colours (red rear position/stop/retro-reflector, white reversing), number and categories of the lamps meet paragraphs 5.15., 5.16. and the individual lamp specifications.

requirements.text: For control of conformity of production, the presence, number, colour, arrangement and, where applicable, the category of lamps shall be checked by visual inspection of the lamps and their markings.
requirements.test_case: Visually inspect the rear lamps and their markings on a production vehicle for presence, number, colour, arrangement and category.

requirements.text: Lamps not satisfying the provisions of any of those Regulations shall not be part of such unit of grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps.
requirements.test_case: Review the function list of the combination lamp and confirm that no integrated lamp lacks compliance evidence against an applicable Regulation.

requirements.text: When two or more lamps are part of the same unit of grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps, approval may be granted only if each of these lamps satisfy the provisions set out in this Regulation or in another Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Verify that the rear position, stop and reversing lamp functions and the retro-reflector of the combination unit each have test results showing compliance with UN R148 or another applicable Regulation.

requirements.text: Every device belonging to an approved type shall comprise a space of sufficient size for the approval marking and other markings as defined in paragraphs 3.3.3.2. to 3.3.3.6.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the drawing/sample for a marking space large enough to carry the approval marking and other required markings.

requirements.text: All markings shall be clearly legible and indelible.
requirements.test_case: Visually inspect and perform a rub test on markings; they shall remain legible.

requirements.text: With regard to the size of the approval marking the value for “a” shall be at least 5 mm.
requirements.test_case: Measure dimension "a" of the approval marking; it shall be at least 5 mm.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall consist of the approval mark, i.e. a circle surrounding the letter "E" followed by the distinguishing number of the country which has granted approval.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the marking for a circle surrounding "E" followed by the approving country number.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall consist of the four to six-digit sequential number, being part of the approval number prescribed in paragraph 3.2.3.2.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the marking for the 4 to 6-digit sequential number of the approval number.

requirements.text: The four to six-digit sequential number shall be placed close to the approval mark.
requirements.test_case: Verify the sequential number is located adjacent to the E-circle mark.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall consist of the symbols identifying the light signalling lamps prescribed in paragraph 3.2.4.
requirements.test_case: Check the marking contains the function symbols (e.g. R1/R2, S1/S2, AR) per Table 1.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall consist of the number of this Regulation followed by the letter 'R' and the two digits indicating the series of amendments in force at the time of issue of the approval.
requirements.test_case: Check the marking shows "148R" followed by the two-digit series of amendments.

requirements.text: On lamps which cannot be mounted on either side of the vehicle indiscriminately, the approval marking shall consist of a horizontal arrow showing in which position the lamp is to be mounted.
requirements.test_case: For a handed lamp, check the marking includes a horizontal arrow indicating mounting position.

requirements.text: The arrow shall be directed outwards from the vehicle in the case of rear position lamps.
requirements.test_case: Verify the horizontal arrow on the rear position lamp points outwards from the vehicle when installed.

requirements.text: The arrow shall be directed outwards from the vehicle in the case of reversing lamps in case of reduced light distribution of two reversing lamps.
requirements.test_case: Verify the horizontal arrow on the reversing lamp points outwards from the vehicle when installed.

requirements.text: On lamps with reduced light distribution, see paragraph 1.1. of Annex 3, the approval marking shall consist of a vertical arrow starting from a horizontal segment and directed downwards.
requirements.test_case: For a lamp with reduced light distribution, check the marking includes a downward vertical arrow from a horizontal segment.

requirements.text: Lamps shall bear the approval marking.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the lamp sample for presence of the approval marking.

requirements.text: Lamps shall bear the trade name or mark of the applicant.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the lamp for the applicant's trade name or mark.

requirements.text: Lamps shall, with the exception of lamps with non-replaceable light sources, bear a marking indicating the category or categories of light source(s) prescribed.
requirements.test_case: If light sources are replaceable, check the lamp is marked with the prescribed light source categories.

requirements.text: In the case of lamps with non-replaceable light sources, the lamps shall bear marking of the rated voltage(s) (i.e. 6V, 12V or 24V) or the range of voltage.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the lamp for a rated voltage or voltage range marking; pass if present and matching the design voltage.

requirements.text: In the case of lamps with an electronic light source control gear, the lamps shall bear marking of the rated voltage(s) (i.e. 6V, 12V or 24V) or the range of voltage.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the lamp for a rated voltage (6V, 12V or 24V) or voltage range marking; pass if present and correct.

requirements.text: In case replaceable light source module(s) is/are used, the light source module(s) shall bear the trade name or mark of the applicant.
requirements.test_case: Inspect each replaceable module for the applicant's trade name or mark; pass if present.

requirements.text: In case replaceable light source module(s) is/are used, the light source module(s) shall bear the specific identification code of the module.
requirements.test_case: Inspect each module for its specific identification code; pass if present.

requirements.text: The specific identification code of the module shall comprise the starting letters “MD” for “MODULE” followed by the approval mark without the circle as prescribed in paragraph 3.3.2.1.1., and in case several non-identical light source modules are used, followed by additional symbols or characters.
requirements.test_case: Check the module code starts with 'MD' followed by the approval mark without circle (plus distinguishing characters for non-identical modules).

requirements.text: In case replaceable light source module(s) is/are used, the light source module(s) shall bear the rated voltage(s) or the range of voltage.
requirements.test_case: Inspect each module for rated voltage or voltage range marking; pass if present.

requirements.text: In case replaceable light source module(s) is/are used, the lamp shall bear the specific identification code of the module as prescribed in paragraph 3.3.3.5. (a), (ii).
requirements.test_case: Inspect the lamp for the module identification code; pass if present and matching the module.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall be placed on an inner or outer part (transparent or not) of the lamp which is not designed to be separated from the transparent part of the lamp emitting the light.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the lamp: pass if the approval marking is on a part not designed to be separated from the light-emitting transparent part.

requirements.text: In any case the approval marking as well as the category or categories of LED substitute light source(s) prescribed, if any, shall be visible when the lamp is fitted on the vehicle or when a movable part such as the hood or boot lid or a door is opened.
requirements.test_case: Fit the lamp on the vehicle and check the approval marking is visible, directly or with boot lid/door opened.

requirements.text: If the outer lens of a device is designed to be separated from the main body, the approval marking shall be placed on both, the detachable lens and the main body.
requirements.test_case: Inspect detachable lens and main body; pass if both carry the approval marking.

requirements.text: In case an outer lens is used for several devices and bearing different approval markings, the main body of each device shall bear only the approval marking of the function(s) of that device.
requirements.test_case: Inspect each device main body; pass if it bears only the approval marking of its own function(s).

requirements.text: The approval marking and the markings in paragraphs 3.3.3.2., 3.3.3.3., 3.3.3.4., 3.3.3.5. (b) and 3.3.3.6. shall be affixed on the lamp.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the lamp; pass if the approval marking and applicable markings of 3.3.3.2–3.3.3.6 are affixed on the lamp.

requirements.text: Where grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps have been found to comply with the requirements of several UN Regulations, a single approval mark with the four to six-digit sequential number may be affixed, and this marking may be located anywhere on the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps, provided that the conditions of paragraphs 3.3.5.1.1. and 3.3.5.1.2. are met.
requirements.test_case: Check the single approval mark carries the sequential number and its location satisfies 3.3.5.1.1 and 3.3.5.1.2.

requirements.text: Where a single approval mark is affixed on grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps, the single approval mark shall be visible after their installation.
requirements.test_case: Install the lamp and verify the single approval mark is visible.

requirements.text: Where a single approval mark is affixed on grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps, no part of the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps that transmits light can be removed without at the same time removing the approval mark.
requirements.test_case: Check that removing any light-transmitting part also removes the approval mark.

requirements.text: The size of the components of a single approval mark shall not be less than the minimum size required for the smallest of the individual marks by the pertinent UN Regulations under which approval has been granted.
requirements.test_case: Measure the single approval mark components; pass if not smaller than the smallest minimum size of the individual marks.

requirements.text: Each lamp submitted for approval shall conform to the requirements set forth in paragraphs 4. and 5.
requirements.test_case: Verify via test report that the lamp meets all requirements of paragraphs 4 and 5.

requirements.text: The requirements contained in sections 5 "General specifications" and 6 "Individual specifications" (and in the Annexes referenced in the said sections) of UN Regulations Nos. 48, 53, 74 or 86, and their series of amendments in force at the time of application for the lamp type approval shall apply to this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Review the lamp against sections 5 and 6 of the UN R48 series in force at application and confirm each pertinent general and individual specification is met.

requirements.text: The requirements pertinent to each lamp and to the category/ies of vehicle on which the lamp is intended to be installed shall be applied, where its verification at the moment of lamp type approval is feasible.
requirements.test_case: Check that the R48 requirements pertinent to each lamp function and to the M1 category that are verifiable at lamp approval have been assessed and are met.

requirements.text: The lamps shall be so designed and constructed that in normal conditions of use, and notwithstanding the vibrations to which they may be subjected in such use, their satisfactory operation remains assured and they retain the characteristics prescribed by this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Subject the lamp to vibration representative of normal use, then verify it operates and still meets the prescribed photometric and colorimetric characteristics.

requirements.text: In the case of a rear position lamp reciprocally incorporated with a stop lamp, the rear position lamp and stop lamp functions shall either: (a) be provided by multiple light sources (for instance, a double filament light source); or (b) be intended for use in a vehicle equipped with a tell-tale indicating failure for the lamps.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the design and confirm that the rear position and stop functions use multiple light sources, or that the lamp is declared for vehicles with a failure tell-tale.

requirements.text: Stop lamps, direction indicator lamps, and reversing lamps shall not incorporate a logo.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the apparent surfaces of the stop lamp and reversing lamp functions and confirm that no logo is incorporated.

requirements.text: The internal structure of the optical components and/or the texture of the outer lens inside of the apparent surface of a lamp (function) may incorporate only one manufacturer logo build by transparent or non-transparent components, provided that all requirements for the specific function of this Regulation are fulfilled and in addition the conditions of paragraph 4.5.5. (a) to (d) are met.
requirements.test_case: If a logo is present, verify that there is only one logo and that the function still meets all its photometric and colorimetric requirements with the logo.

requirements.text: Irrespective of the marking requirements in paragraph 3.3., only the logo of the brand name of the vehicle manufacturer or the body manufacturer shall be allowed in the apparent surface of a lamp (function).
requirements.test_case: Inspect the logo and confirm that it is the brand name logo of the vehicle or body manufacturer only.

requirements.text: The enclosed light emitting surface of the logo (incorporating transparent and non-transparent components of the logo) of such a lamp in the direction of the reference axis shall not exceed 100 cm2.
requirements.test_case: Measure the enclosed logo light emitting surface projected in the reference axis direction and confirm it is ≤ 100 cm2.

requirements.text: In a single lamp containing more than one light source, a group of light sources, wired so that the failure of any one of them causes all of them to stop emitting light, shall be considered to be one light source.
requirements.test_case: Review the LED wiring schematic and confirm that series-wired LED groups are treated as single light sources in the failure assessment.

requirements.text: In case of failure of any one light source in a single lamp containing more than one light source, at least one of the following provisions shall apply: (a) The light intensity complies with the minimum intensity required in the pertinent table of standard light distribution as shown in Annex 3 and when all light sources are illuminated the maximum intensities shall not be exceeded; or (b) A signal for activation of a tell-tale indicating failure, as indicated in paragraphs 6.4.8., 6.7.8., 6.9.8, 6.10.8., 6.11.8., 6.12.8., 6.13.8. and 6.18.8. of UN Regulation No. 48, is produced.
requirements.test_case: Disable each light source (group) in turn and confirm that the minimum Annex 3 intensities are still met with maximums not exceeded when all sources are lit, or that a failure tell-tale signal is produced.

requirements.text: In case of failure of the variable intensity control of a rear position lamp category R2 emitting more than the maximum value of category R1, requirements of steady luminous intensity of the respective category shall be fulfilled automatically.
requirements.test_case: Simulate failure of the variable intensity control and measure intensity; verify it automatically meets the steady (R1) luminous intensity requirements.

requirements.text: The lamp shall only be equipped with: replaceable light source(s) approved according to UN Regulations Nos. 37, 99 and/or 128, provided that no restriction on the use is made at the time of application for type approval, and/or light source module(s) and/or non-replaceable light source(s).
